raw: I usually do the crossword over coffee in the morning. I spread the newspaper across the counter and work on it with a pencil. The eraser’s pretty worn down, but I still use it. I look through the clues and fill in the ones I know first, then go back to the ones that didn’t come to me right away. Sometimes getting a few letters makes a clue seem obvious when it wasn’t before. That’s mostly what’s on my mind while I’m sitting there—trying to get the words to fit, having my coffee. It’s a familiar way to start the morning.
